items.question: ¿Artistas reconocidos y empresas pueden pagar al finalizar el trabajo?
items.answer: Yes, on request and subject to review. Established artists and corporate companies can tick "Pay after completion" when ordering. We review the request; if approved, the campaign starts, we share the report when the work is done, and payment is collected afterwards. Requests that are not approved continue with the standard payment flow.

items.question: Are Google Ads views safe?
items.answer: Yes, they are 100% safe. We use Google's own advertising platform. It works just like YouTube's own ads and will not harm your channel in any way.

items.question: How quickly will I see results?
items.answer: Delivery speed depends on the video and the targeting; it can sometimes be completed within a single day. The confirmed timing is stated in your quote.

items.question: Will my channel get penalized?
items.answer: No, absolutely not. Google Ads is Google's own product and YouTube advertising is completely legal and fully compliant with platform policies.

items.question: ¿Las vistas caerán con el tiempo?
items.answer: Views from Google Ads come from real users, so they are permanent. We do not use bots or fake views.

items.question: How does the quote, analysis, and payment process work?
items.answer: Submit your quote, we will analyze your video and reply in detail via WhatsApp or Telegram; work begins upon approval. Pricing may vary based on video length.

items.question: Can you do audience targeting?
items.answer: Yes! We use Google Ads' advanced targeting features. We can target by country, city, age, gender, and interests.
